environment.description: Same EKS 1.27 cluster but namespace has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Pod Security Standards v1.27 restricted profile). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path-and-privilege' with spec.validationFailureAction: Enforce contains rules: (1) deny spec.containers[*].securityContext.privileged=true, (2) deny spec.volumes[*].hostPath, (3) require spec.containers[*].securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, (4) require spec.containers[*].securityContext.runAsNonRoot=true. Container runs with seccomp profile RuntimeDefault. The jemalloc allocator is compiled with opt.abort_conf:true and opt.tcache:false providing deterministic double-free abort behavior.
